content.label: This is a great app and I love it so so much but one problem is that very little things in the app is in my language English. It’s mainly Japanese witch annoys me since I really want to use these stickers but I try to click on them and it shows me a screen that’s all in Japanese so I don’t know what to do. I can only access very little things. All of them are mainly on English. I had to ask my Japanese friend to help me solve these things since she introduced me to this app. So please add an English feature if you can! Thanks! 𓊆ྀི❤︎𓊇ྀི
